# Vertex Security Solutions

> Vertex Security Solutions is a Bangladesh-based Security Training, Risk Consultancy, and Security Technology firm dedicated to helping organizations protect their people, assets, operations, information, and reputation through integrated, risk-based security solutions.

Vertex does not simply provide security guards or services — it enhances security capability through professional training, strategic consultancy, and practical technology solutions tailored to each client's operational and organizational needs. Vertex is based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, and serves clients across Bangladesh.

Founder & Principal Security Consultant: Major Khalil Ahmed Khan (Retd.), psc, MDS, MBA, SRMP-C — 42+ years of leadership experience across the Bangladesh Army, United Nations Peacekeeping Missions, the U.S. Embassy in Dhaka, and senior leadership roles (AVP/VP/SVP) at G4S Bangladesh.

## Service Pillars

- Professional Security Training — competency-based training for security guards, supervisors, in-charges, and managers, including executive protection, close protection, event and travel security, CCTV monitoring, access control, patrolling, incident investigation, emergency response, and fire safety.
- Security Risk Consultancy — security risk assessments, threat and vulnerability assessments, physical security surveys, security audits, master planning, SOP and policy development, crisis management and business continuity planning.
- Security Technology — independent advisory on CCTV, access control, intrusion alarms, visitor management, perimeter security, biometrics, and integrated command & control centres.
- Executive Protection — close protection, VIP and residential security, travel security, and protective advance planning.
- Background Screening — pre-employment checks, reference and employment verification, criminal record checks, and vendor/contractor vetting.
- RMG Security & Compliance Solutions — a dedicated vertical for Bangladesh's Ready-Made Garment industry, covering C-TPAT security awareness, supply chain and cargo security, factory security assessments, fire safety, and buyer compliance training.

## Industries Served

Banks & Financial Institutions, Multinational Companies, Pharmaceuticals, Hospitals & Healthcare, Educational Institutions, Embassies & Diplomatic Missions, NGOs & International Organizations, Telecommunications, Logistics & Warehousing, Power & Energy, Corporate Offices, and Ready-Made Garments (RMG).
